paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Average overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs across both KGDS patterns. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{avg} [61, 69]), Tier-2 (OP_{avg} [53, 56]), and Tier-3 (OP_{avg} [29, 37]).
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average overall performance (in percent) for a set of large language models (LLMs) evaluated across both knowledge-grounded discussion summarization (KGDS) patterns, with each bar representing one model’s average performance value. The category axis is horizontal, showing a sequence of individual bars with no visible category names on the axis (the bars appear in an unlabeled left-to-right order), and there is no legend; each bar is distinguished by a different muted/pastel fill color. The value axis is vertical and labeled “Average Performance (%)”, using a linear scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 20, 40, and 60, and the plotted values extend to just under 70%. There are 12 vertical bars with numeric value annotations printed above them: from left to right the bars are approximately 68.66 (green-gray), 61.11 (lavender-gray), 29.44 (blue-gray), 66.41 (mauve), 62.98 (light steel-blue), 36.62 (tan), 65.77 (light blue), 55.69 (light lavender), 55.00 (beige), 55.30 (light gray), 52.61 (pale yellow-gray), and 55.55 (very light pink). The smallest annotated value is 29.44 and the largest is 68.66, and all bars are presented with similar width and no visible outlines or special emphasis beyond the value labels.
